pricingDoctrine: Products are premade / resident inventory before user selection.
A user request selects and routes an existing product candidate; it does not invent the product.
Product path is premade resident inventory -> buyer selection -> DP packaging -> Release Gate -> Dispatch.
Donation/support is optional and separate from product price.

tiers.minimumShape: One sound, word, short phrase, or micro-expression.
tiers.buyerMeaning: A tiny emotional signal for a quick HUG touch.

tiers.minimumShape: At least 2 paired lines, phrases, or expressions.
tiers.buyerMeaning: A short emotional pair with more shape than a tiny unit.

tiers.minimumShape: One approved premade resident K-KUT-scale music moment.

tiers.minimumShape: Two or more connected K-KUT moments, usually contiguous.
tiers.buyerMeaning: A bigger connected statement with more emotional arc.

tiers.minimumShape: A gift-ready Father’s Day delivery package.

optionalSupport.buyerMeaning: Optional support helps keep real emotional audio moments alive and available.
